description: This file defines the OrderItemViewModel class, which is used as a ViewModel in the web layer of the eShopOnWeb project to represent items in an order, including product details, price, discount, quantity, and image URL.

classes.name: OrderItemViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class representing an individual item in an order, including product info, pricing, quantity, and image URL.

methods.name: ProductId
methods.description: Getter and setter for the product's identifier.

methods.name: ProductName
methods.description: Getter and setter for the product's name; nullable string.

methods.name: UnitPrice
methods.description: Getter and setter for the unit price of the product.

methods.name: Discount
methods.description: Read-only property returning a fixed discount value of 0; can be overridden for dynamic discounts.

methods.name: Units
methods.description: Getter and setter for the quantity of the product.

methods.name: PictureUrl
methods.description: Getter and setter for the URL of the product's picture; nullable string.
